title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF strengthened its leadership in child advocacy, rallying millions through campaigns, partnerships, and volunteer efforts. Advocates, influencers, and media highlighted key issues like parenting, climate change, and child rights. Initiatives like I Am UNICEF and U-Report amplified youth voices, while tailored content and outreach boosted awareness nationwide.
